Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using the DSBU cross-linker to determine the quaternary structure of the CF II complex. While 'mod_complexome' is the closest modifier for structural/complex analysis, the primary signal is the use of DSBU for cross-linking. Dimethylation of arginine was noted in the text as detected by MS, though not the primary goal of the PXD010177 dataset.

cell_lines: A stable HEK293 cell line expressing His-FLAG-tagged hClp1
Sf21 cells cultured in ExCell 420 serum-free medium
scope: Affinity purification via Flag beads followed by Ni2+ beads
The lysate was clarified by centrifugation and applied to Ni-NTA agarose
In-gel digestion of cross-linked protein complexes with trypsin, data acquisition, and analysis were done as previously described
Three gel bands of high molecular weight cross-linked complexes were analyzed separately by LC/MS/MS

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (PXD010177) specifically targeted the purified CF II complex (hPcf11 and hClp1) and its cross-linked forms, produced via recombinant expression in Sf21 cells and purified by affinity chromatography.

evidence: We have reconstituted CF II as a heterodimer of hPcf11 and hClp1.
